entryAchievement.title: Better Living Through Chemistry
entryAchievement.text: You entered the Dungeon carrying enough assorted pharmaceuticals to make both a pharmacist and a narcotics officer deeply uncomfortable. Prescription pills. Over the counter medication. Recreational substances. You weren't prepared for the apocalypse. You were prepared for Tuesday.
entryAchievement.reward: You've been awarded a Gold Junkie Box! The box would contain a Field Testing Kit that functions as a Tier 0 alchemy table for simple alchemical tasks and has the special ability to convert mundane drugs into Dungeon Drugs.

entryAchievement.title: Actually, it's Gucci
entryAchievement.text: You entered the World Dungeon wearing over $1000 worth of clothing. You know what they say, you can't buy a personality. You sure tried though, didn't you? Too bad it's all worthless now.
entryAchievement.reward: You've received a Golden Apparel Box. Inside the box is a Quick Change Jacket that lets you change your outfit into anything (mundane) when you're in a safe room.

crawlers.name: The Stuntman
crawlers.concept: Thrill-seeking stunt performer - bombastic, flashy, does everything the showy way.

entryAchievement.title: Method Acting
entryAchievement.text: You entered the Dungeon dressed as a monster. Well, partly dressed as one anyways. Most people take years of therapy to understand what they truly are. You saved yourself a fortune.
entryAchievement.reward: You've received a Golden Monster Box! Inside is a bottle of Liquid Latex. Once per day, you can use the liquid latex to attach part of a dungeon mob to you and it becomes fully functional, similar to Odette's ability in the books.

entryAchievement.title: Middling Manager
entryAchievement.text: You entered the dungeon with a bunch of people that you manage. Guess none of your friends are available? I bet you'll make sure they all clock in on time even after the apocalypse.
entryAchievement.reward: You've received a Golden Bosses Box (not a boss box, sorry). Inside is a golden folder, but it only has the Set Layout for now. Every morning, it populates with a broader map of the area including labelled sections.

entryAchievement.title: Didn't Predict This, Did You?
entryAchievement.text: You entered the World Dungeon carrying a Tarot deck. You know, if those cards were actually worth a damn, maybe you'd have stayed home.
entryAchievement.reward: You've received a Golden Witch Box. Inside the box is a Deck of Minor Catastrophes. It's a tarot deck that only contains five of the major arcana right now. In the morning, you can pull from this deck to get essentially a consumable for the day based of the arcana you pull. Chariot gives you the ability to teleport yourself or a party member within 10 feet to anywhere you can see within 50ft, for example.
